verdict.rationale: Make's documented webhooks are inbound: they create a URL that external services call to trigger a scenario. Nothing in the evidence shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that let a programmatic consumer subscribe to Make platform events. The custom-app Webhooks component and MCP webhook management also concern inbound trigger URLs, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: custom webhooks allow you to create a url to which you can send any data
webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service
